claims.text: rank_pairs validates each card, rejects duplicate identities and requires identical task_ids across compared series.
rank_pairs orders by exact correctness ratio, breaking ties by cost only when every tied card has no unknown cost for the chosen metric.
_validate requires correctness to equal n_correct over n_tasks exactly and cost means to equal total over known exactly.

decision.rule: Change here when ranking order, cost tie-breaking, task-set comparability or card validation needs to change.
decision.failure: A pair is ranked by cost despite unknown costs, or an inexact correctness ratio is accepted.

questions.q: Where does rank_pairs validate scorecards before ranking?
Where should I change correctness ordering or cost tie-breaking?
Where can I debug a ranking failure from mismatched task sets?
